assumptions.statement: 24 anonymous workers +8 visitors is a conditional design attendance scenario, not observed September 2026 headcount. Up to six visitors sleep temporarily; those guests are a subset, not additional employees.
All dimensions, bench capacities, room counts, six short-stay beds and floor configuration are intentionally modelled. Three named sheds and outdoor Museum derive from accepted Willow canon.

Research safeguards depend on actual experiments: ventilation, containment, utility isolation and fire classification require project-specific review. No installed plant, lifting equipment or hazardous process is inferred.

access.parking_basis: 32-person planned peak ×85% car mode /1.1 occupants ≈25 cars;30 spaces allow accessible and service parking. No observed commuting survey.

adjacency.reason: Equipment intake and quarantine precede research; a released transfer uses hardstand, not visitor reception.
